fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 10 June 2026 states the adopted texts create ANSSI, mandated for cybersecurity and coordinating the response to cyberattacks.
The communique states the Government adopted the National Cybersecurity Strategy and its 2026-2030 Action Plan by Decree n°2026-0097/PT-RM of 25 February 2026.
system: Stratégie nationale de Cybersécurité du Mali

fact: The Council of Ministers formally took note of Mali's National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030, described as the country's first coordinated national cyber framework; the article's title says Mali adopts it. Date taken from the article as 2025-12 (it gives 5 December 2025).

Decree n°2026-0097/PT-RM, published in the Journal Officiel of 6 March 2026, approves the National Cybersecurity Strategy (SNCS) and its 2026-2030 action plan; the decree's own date is not in the passages, so the gazette date is used.
